headlines.description: Michael Carrick's future at Manchester United looks increasingly untenable after his side imploded in the second half to lose 2-0 against Chelsea.
headlines.shortLinkText: Carrick on the brink as Man Utd lose at Chelsea

headlines.description: A calamitous error from Leeds goalkeeper James Trafford set in-form AFC Bournemouth on course for a 2-0 Premier League victory at the Vitality Stadium.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bournemouth roll on as Trafford error costs Leeds

headlines.description: Igor Thiago was back among the goals while Nottingham Forest fired blanks again in a 2-0 defeat at Brentford.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brentford crank up pressure on Glasner as Forest lose 2-0

headlines.description: Coventry City climbed out of the relegation zone with a 3-1 win over Sunderland that leaves the Black Cats rooted to the bottom of the Premier League.
headlines.shortLinkText: Coventry stun Sunderland, out of relegation zone

headlines.description: Hull maintained their unbeaten home record but saw their winless run continue after a cat-and-mouse 2-2 draw with Ipswich at the MKM Stadium.
headlines.shortLinkText: Julio Enciso salvages point for Ipswich at Hull

headlines.description: Brighton avenged their Carabao Cup loss to Manchester City as they held on for a narrow 1-0 win over the Premier League leaders on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: In-form Brighton inflict 2nd straight defeat on City

events.name: Brighton & Hove Albion at Manchester City

headlines.description: Tottenham Hotspur made it three Premier League wins in a row for the first time in 20 months with a comfortable 2-0 victory over 10-man Crystal Palace.
headlines.shortLinkText: Spurs resurgence continues with win over 10-man Palace

headlines.description: A howler from Zion Suzuki helped Fulham earn a 1-1 draw against Aston Villa at Villa Park on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Suzuki fumble sees Villa held to draw by Fulham
